dossier_meta.statement_text: If $G$ is a universally cell 3-colorable graph which does not have a subcontraction isomorphic to $K^+_{3,n-3}$ for some $n \geq 7$, then $G$ is 3-flowable.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper exhibits an infinite family of universally cell 3-colorable graphs ($K^+_{3,n-3}$ for $n \geq 7$) that do not admit a nowhere-zero 3-flow, showing the two properties are not equivalent in general. The authors believe excluding these graphs as subcontractions is sufficient to recover equivalence between universal cell 3-colorability and 3-flowability. Remarkably, a positive resolution of this conjecture would also imply Tutte's 3-Flow Conjecture.
